name: ⭐ TOP TODO — Project Workflow Rules
observations: SABSE PEHLE: Koi bhi naya project banane se pehle us project se related skills install karna ZAROORI hai. Skills install ke bina project shuru NAHI karna.

Project start checklist: (1) find-skills skill se project-related skills dhoondo: 'npx skills find <topic>' (2) Install karo: 'npx skills add <owner/repo@skill> -g -y' (3) Skills verify karo: 'npx skills list' (4) Uske BAAD project par kaam shuru karo.
Skills Directory: https://skills.sh — yahan se koi bhi skill milegi.
find-skills skill globally installed hai: ~/.agents/skills/find-skills (vercel-labs/skills@find-skills, 4M+ installs).
Example: Android app project shuru karne se pehle Android/Compose related skill install karo, phir coding shuru karo.
Ye rule har project par apply hota hai — chhota ho ya bada.
FULL RULES: entity '⭐ MASTER PROJECT RULES (ALL PROJECTS)' me save hain — har project se pehle wahi follow karo.
Workflow: BRAIN.md padho → Skills install karo → Zaroori tools (user se puch ke) → Memory me TODO → Plan summary → User confirmation → Build → Sab functions test karo → Tab report karo.

name: ⭐ MASTER PROJECT RULES (ALL PROJECTS)
observations: RULE 1 — FREE & OPEN SOURCE ONLY: Kisi bhi app/web/project me sirf FREE aur OPEN-SOURCE tools, libraries aur services use karni hain (examples: Vercel free hosting, Supabase free tier, Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, GitHub Pages). Paid cheez use NAHI karni.
RULE 2 — FREE HOSTING PLAN PEHLE: Har naye project ke START me hi plan banana hai ki project ko FREE me kaise banana aur host karna hai. Ye planning project shuru karne se PEHLE hogi.

RULE 3 — WORKFLOW ORDER (compulsory): (1) Project ki BRAIN.md padho (agar project purana hai) (2) PEHLE project-related SKILLS install karo (npx skills find <topic> → npx skills add <owner/repo@skill> -g -y) (3) Phir zaroorat-mand TOOLS — agar tool zaroori nahi hai to user se PUCH KE install karo, internet se find karke (4) Memory me TODO add karo aur project ke parts banao (5) Final plan summary do user ko (stack, free hosting, parts, risks) (6) User ki confirmation ke BAAD project build karo.

RULE 4 — FINAL PLAN SUMMARY: Project banane se pehle user ko poora plan summary dena hai — kya banega, kaise banega, free hosting kahan hogi, project ke parts kya honge — phir confirmation ke baad hi aage badhna.

RULE 5 — BRAIN FILE HAR PROJECT ME: Har project ke root me ek BRAIN.md file banani hai. Isme sirf ye hona chahiye: (a) project kya hai (b) kya karna hai / next steps (c) stack + free hosting plan (d) parts aur unka status (e) important decisions. Jab bhi project par wapas kaam karna ho, SABSE PEHLE BRAIN.md padhna hai — isse tokens kam kharch honge. Har work session ke baad BRAIN.md update karni hai.

RULE 6 — TESTING BEFORE REPORTING: APK ya web banne ke baad PEHLE khud saare options aur saare functions check karne hai. Jab sab kuch actually kaam kar raha ho tabhi user ko 'done' batana hai. Bina test kiye complete mat bolo.

RULE 7 — ISSUE REPORTING: Agar project banate time koi issue aa raha hai to user ko batana hai: (a) ye issue hai (b) ye aise solve hoga (c) ye changes honge — aur user se YES/NO puchna hai ki karna hai ya nahi. User ki permission ke bina approach change nahi karni.
RULE 8 — PERSISTENCE: Ye rules HAR session aur HAR naye chat me follow karne hain, chahe session change ho jaye. Memory aur AGENTS.md dono me save hain — hamesha yaad rakhna.
RULE 9 — TODO IN MEMORY: Project shuru karne se PEHLE memory me us project ka TODO add karna hai, project ke parts define karne hain, aur jab ek part complete ho to memory me status update karna hai.

RULE 5 (STRICT) — BRAIN.md COMPULSORY: Har naye project ke root me BRAIN.md file banana zaroori hai. BRAIN.md banane ke bina koi project start NAHI hoga. Ye project ka PEHLA step hai (skills/tools se bhi pehle).

BRAIN.md TEMPLATE: # BRAIN — [Project Name] | ## 1. Project kya hai | ## 2. Kya karna hai / Next Steps | ## 3. Stack + Free Hosting Plan | ## 4. Parts + Status (✅ done / 🔄 in progress / ⬜ pending) | ## 5. Important Decisions | ## 6. Last Updated (date)

RULE 10 — CONTINUOUS LEARNING: Har task se pehle ~/.agents/knowledge/LEARNINGS.md me relevant lessons search karo; non-trivial solution ke baad entry add karo. Project-specific lessons BRAIN.md me, general lessons global KB me. Secrets kabhi nahi. Session end pe BRAIN.md + max 3 lessons update karo.

RULE 11 — TOKEN 90% PORT ROTATION: context usage 90%+ ho to turant user ko batao, YES/NO pucho; YES par `port-rotate --apply` chalao. Port pool ~/.config/opencode/ports.txt me 20 ports line-wise (28960–28979). Port change tokens reset nahi karta — compact/new session recommended.

RULE 11 UPDATED — TOKEN GUARD 80%: context 80%+ ho to user ko batao aur YES/NO pucho. Options: (A) context-reset --apply (compact, session same, recommended), (B) model-rotate --apply (free model switch), (C) port-rotate --apply (20-port pool). Port change tokens reset nahi karta; compaction free karta hai.

name: 📚 CONTINUOUS LEARNING SYSTEM
observations: Location: ~/.agents/knowledge/LEARNINGS.md — global cross-project lessons. Project-specific lessons go in <project>/BRAIN.md.
Skill: ~/.agents/skills/learnings/SKILL.md (installed, available to OpenCode).

Protocol: BEFORE a task, grep relevant tags in LEARNINGS.md and read only matching entries. AFTER a non-trivial fix, append a concise entry (date, tags, problem, cause, fix, verify, reuse) plus a Quick Index row.
Never store secrets, tokens, passwords, or API keys in the knowledge base.
Consolidation: when the file exceeds ~400 lines or a tag has 5+ entries, merge duplicates into Playbook sections.

Seeded with 10 real lessons: OpenCode 'environment' key, mcp add bug, npx timeout fix, jadx JAVA_HOME, apksigner/zipalign, gh token login, skills.sh auth, pkg search quirk, MCP token cost, Code Mode catalog.
GitHub backup of the knowledge base: pending user confirmation (private repo recommended).

name: ⚙️ TOKEN GUARD (80%) — COMPACT / MODEL / PORT
observations: TRIGGER: context usage >= 80%.
CHECK: run `token-usage` after every major step (last assistant message tokens vs /api/model limit).
NOTIFY: immediately tell the user '⚠️ Token 80% ho gaye hain.'
APPROVAL: ask YES/NO before any action.
OPTION A (recommended): `context-reset --apply` — compaction, session same, context freed.
OPTION B: `model-rotate --apply` — switch to next free model from models.txt, session same.
OPTION C: `port-rotate --apply` — change server port from the 20-port pool.
POOLS: ~/.config/opencode/ports.txt (20 ports, 28960–28979) and ~/.config/opencode/models.txt (9 free models), both line-wise.
STATE: ~/.config/opencode/port-index and model-index. LOGS: ~/.local/state/opencode/.
VERIFY: `token-usage` after compaction/model switch; `opencode service status` after port rotation.
CAVEAT: port rotation does NOT reset tokens; compaction frees context; model switch changes the model's context limit/quota.
Auto-compaction triggers around 85%; the manual 80% check gives control before that.
